svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, the same as FieldNode's V-blocks. Saw a 20 mm slice off

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 x 40 bar; saw and file it to 60 wide x 33 deep x 20 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The flat back goes on the junction box plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe a 90 degree V on both 60 x 33 faces with a 45 degree square:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50.3 wide at the front face, point 7.8 from the back face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw just inside both lines, file to the lines, keep the faces flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the V's front edges 0.5 mm so they cannot scratch the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3, 14 deep, and tap M4 12 deep in the back face, 18 each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of centre, half way up (10).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M4 countersunk screws from the front of the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 48.3 post touches both V faces; it never touches the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on the post the block must not rock; light shows at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom of the V, not along its faces.
